verdict.rationale: Vue's official Custom Renderer API documents createRenderer(), which takes platform-specific node creation and manipulation APIs so Vue's core runtime can target non-DOM environments. The page documents the full RendererOptions interface and @vue/runtime-core. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a shipped non-DOM custom renderer target.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write custom renderers so the framework's component model can target platforms other than the browser DOM

citations.quote: Creates a custom renderer. By providing platform-specific node creation and manipulation APIs, you can leverage Vue's core runtime to target non-DOM environments.
The page documents the full RendererOptions interface (createElement, patchProp, insert, remove, ...) and @vue/runtime-core.
